name: Ariston Holding NV
reason: Family-controlled boiler/water-heater maker whose GAAP EPS fell from EUR 0.51 (2023) to 0.01 (2024) and 0.36 (2025) as EU heat-pump subsidy and regulatory shifts whipsawed demand, with 10y avg ROIC 7.3% and a huge adj-vs-GAAP gap (867%); cyclical, policy-driven and not special.

name: Sonaecom SGPS SA
reason: Sonae-controlled holding company with negative EBIT margins every year (-92% in 2025), EPS driven by investment gains (EUR 0.38 in 2021 to 0.06 in 2024), no consensus coverage and no forecastable operating franchise.

name: Koninklijke Ahold Delhaize N.V.
reason: Durable US/Benelux grocer but adj EPS has stalled (EUR 2.55 in 2022 to 2.67 in 2025, 5y CAGR 3.4%) on a 3.5% EBIT margin and 7.2% ROIC, with LTG 4% and FY2-FY3 consensus 6.6-7.1% largely from buybacks; cheap but ordinary with no route to 7%+ organic EPS growth.

name: Opera Limited
reason: Browser monetised mainly via search/ad deals (heavy reliance on a single search partner) with volatile adj EPS (USD 0.59 in 2019, 0.05 in 2021, 1.86 in 2023, 1.19 in 2025), Chinese controlling shareholder and a credible AI-browser threat, so 5-10 year earnings cannot be forecast.

name: Melia Hotels International, S.A.
reason: Family-controlled leisure hotel owner-operator at peak-cycle earnings (EBIT margin 15.2%, 91st pctile; adj EPS EUR 0.76 at its 10y high after -2.55 in 2020), with 10y avg ROIC 1.4% and net debt/EBITDA 3.9x; fails the recession and cyclical-peak tests.

name: Altri, SGPS, S.A.
reason: Pulp/cellulose producer whose earnings follow commodity pulp prices (EBIT margin 29.8% in 2018 vs 2.5% in 2025) with net debt/EBITDA 6.8x; commodity-driven and unforecastable.

name: Mony Group PLC
reason: Capital-light UK price-comparison site with 34% avg ROIC and net cash but adj EPS grew only GBP 0.14 to 0.18 over 2015-25 (2.1%/yr), consensus 5-6%, and Google/AI search disintermediation is a credible 5-yr threat; no route to 7%.

name: Deutsche Lufthansa AG
reason: Airline with adj EPS down from EUR 3.59 (2017) to 1.07 (2025) after -7.47 in 2020, 10y avg ROIC 2.3%, shares up 6.3%/yr from rescue dilution and fuel/cycle-driven earnings; fails durable-economics and recession tests.

name: Capgemini SE
reason: Good record (adj EPS EUR 4.69 to 12.95 over 2015-25, 10.7%/yr, stable 11-12% EBIT margin) but growth leans on acquisitions (Altran, WNS; acq 0.49x 10y FCF), EPS has flattened since 2023 with FY1 consensus -6%, and AI is a credible threat to labour-based IT services billing (consistent with G, DOX, EPAM).

name: Fiskars Oyj Abp
reason: Branded homewares/garden tools with adj EPS back to EUR 0.57 in 2025 (same as 2015, -47.5% in 2025), EBIT margin 3.7% vs 8.5% avg, 10y avg ROIC 6.3% and net debt/EBITDA 4.1x; no growth record and no specialness.

name: Sanofi SA
reason: Large pharma with adj EPS only EUR 5.61 to 7.83 over 2015-25 (3.4%/yr), EBIT margin at its 10y high (26.1%, 100th pctile) and heavy dependence on Dupixent ahead of its early-2030s patent expiry; pipeline outcomes make 5-10 year earnings unforecastable.

name: Eni S.p.A.
reason: State-influenced integrated oil major whose adj EPS swings with oil/gas prices (EUR -0.29 in 2016, 3.78 in 2022, 1.62 in 2025) with 10y avg ROIC 3.6%; commodity-driven.

name: UIE PLC
reason: Holding company for United Plantations whose earnings are set by palm-oil prices (EPS USD 3.75 in 2023, 2.37 in 2024, 4.48 in 2025; EBIT margin at 91st pctile), with no consensus coverage; commodity-driven at a cyclical high.

name: Ackermans & van Haaren NV
reason: Well-run Belgian conglomerate (adj EPS EUR 7.69 to 18.10 over 2015-25, 8.9%/yr) but earnings mix peak-margin marine contracting via DEME (EBIT margin 13.6%, 100th pctile), AUM-driven private banking and real estate, with consolidated net debt/EBITDA 6.1x and FY2-FY3 consensus only 1.6-5.2%; too many cyclical drivers to forecast.

name: Supermarket Income REIT Plc
reason: Grocery-property REIT with EPRA EPS flat at GBP 0.06 since 2022 (5y CAGR 0.8%), net debt/EBITDA 7.3x and rate-sensitive valuation; forecastable but no route to 7% growth.

name: DEME Group NV
reason: Offshore-wind/dredging contractor at peak earnings (EPS EUR 13.72 in 2025, 1.0x 10y max; EBIT margin 9.4% vs 5.0% avg, 100th pctile) with FY2 consensus -12.6% and lumpy project-driven history (EUR 1.99 in 2020); near-cyclical-peak rule applies.

name: Enagas SA
reason: Regulated Spanish gas-transmission utility with adj EPS falling every year from EUR 1.99 (2017) to 1.15 (2025) as regulators cut allowed returns, net debt/EBITDA 5.3x and LTG 1.4%; regulated returns with negative growth.

name: Subsea 7 S.A.
reason: Offshore oil and gas contractor whose adj EPS fell from USD 1.60 (2015) to -1.64 (2020) and is recovering to 1.38 (2025) with 10y avg ROIC 0.8%; earnings set by the oil-capex cycle.

name: Whitbread PLC
reason: Premier Inn owner with adj EPS flat at GBP 2.07 in 2025 vs 2.03 in 2015 (after -2.88 in 2020), 10y avg ROIC 3.3%, lease-heavy net debt/EBITDA 5.0x and buybacks 6.4x 10y FCF; strong brand but cyclical with no growth record.

name: LyondellBasell Industries NV
reason: Commodity olefins/polyolefins producer with adj EPS collapsing from USD 18.19 (2021) to 1.70 (2025), EBIT margin 3.2% vs 11.8% avg and net debt/EBITDA 4.7x; earnings set by petrochemical spreads.
